command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== EXACT CURRENT PROVIDER ADMISSION CHECK ==='
date -Is; hostname
T=$(mktemp -d /tmp/avatar-admission-XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$T/repo"
cd "$T/repo"
echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
set +e
python3 tools/free_provider_admission.py --json
RC=$?
set -e
echo ADMISSION_RC=$RC
echo '--- STATIC AUTHORITY KEYS ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(Path('research_entity/claycode/autonomous/FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION.json').read_text())
i=json.loads(Path('research_entity/claycode/autonomous/SUPERVISOR_INBOX.json').read_text())
print('provider.authority_epoch=',p.get('authority_epoch'))
print('provider.mode=',p.get('mode'))
print('provider.source=',p.get('source'))
print('provider.free_swarm=',p.get('free_swarm'))
print('supervisor.schema_version=',i.get('schema_version'))
print('supervisor.provider_policy=',i.get('current_frontier',{}).get('provider_policy'))
print('supervisor.free_swarm_owner_emergency_stop=',i.get('free_only',{}).get('free_swarm_owner_emergency_stop'))
PY
echo '=== END ADMISSION CHECK ==='
